description: This file contains unit tests for the NotificationForwardingPolicy class, including parsing times, package filtering modes, quiet hours behavior, rate limiting, and burst limiter functionality.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicyTest
classes.description: A test suite for NotificationForwardingPolicy, verifying methods related to package filtering, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_parsesValidValues
methods.description: Tests parsing of valid 'HH:MM' time strings into minutes.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_acceptsStrict24HourDrafts
methods.description: Verifies normalization of correct time strings.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_rejectsInvalidValues
methods.description: Ensures invalid time strings are rejected (null returned).

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_rejectsNonCanonicalDrafts
methods.description: Tests rejection of non-canonical or invalid 'HH:MM' formats.

methods.name: allowsPackage_blocklistBlocksConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Tests package blocking in blocklist mode.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_handlesWindowCrossingMidnight
methods.description: Verifies quiet hours logic when start and end times cross midnight.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_sameStartEndMeansAlwaysQuiet
methods.description: Tests behavior when quiet start and end times are the same, meaning always quiet.

methods.name: blocksEventsWhenDisabledOrQuietHoursOrRateLimited
methods.description: Checks that notifications are blocked when disabled, during quiet hours, or rate-limited.

methods.name: burstLimiter_blocksEventsAboveLimitInSameMinute
methods.description: Verifies that burst limiter blocks excess notifications within the same minute.

methods.name: burstLimiter_resetsOnNextMinuteWindow
methods.description: Ensures rate limiter resets allowance on next minute boundary.
